lines: [excited, sports-announcer energy] USA or CHINA. [short pause] Who's WINNING the AI race? [pause] [punchy] Let's check the SCOREBOARD.
[announcer, building] Round ONE: [short pause] the smartest AI. [short pause] [explaining] The best American model beats the best Chinese one [short pause] by just two point SEVEN percent.
[surprised, emphatic] Three years ago, [short pause] that gap was HUGE.
[referee call, crisp] Point, USA. [short pause] [wry] Barely.

[announcer] Round TWO: [short pause] computing power. [short pause] [impressed] America has about SEVENTY-TWO percent of the world's AI computing power. [pause] [teasing] China? [short pause] About TEN.
[referee call, crisp] Point, USA. [short pause] Easily.
[announcer] Round THREE: [short pause] electricity. [short pause] [explaining, energetic] AI EATS power, [short pause] and China is adding power plants about SIX times faster than America.
[referee call, crisp, clear] Point, [short pause] CHINA!

[dramatic, building] Round FOUR: [short pause] the SHOCK. [short pause] In January twenty twenty-five, [short pause] a cheap Chinese AI called DeepSeek [short pause] wiped nearly SIX HUNDRED BILLION dollars off Nvidia [short pause] in ONE day.
[referee call] Point, CHINA. [pause] [amazed] Two... [short pause] TWO.
[slow, dramatic, leaning in] So... [short pause] who WINS?

[clear, confident] Right now, [short pause] America LEADS. [short pause] But China is catching up, [short pause] FAST and CHEAP. [pause] [wry, smiling] The race isn't over. [short pause] It's barely past the FIRST lap.
